title: Neuron features match the real layer better in all four layers, but no layer clears both bars
subtitle: GPT-2 small, public transcoders, layers 8 to 11. Each nudge to the MLP layer's input switches one feature off. We compare the transcoder's change in the true next word's logit with the real layer's change.
panelA: Agreement (R²) per layer and feature group
panelA_note: 1 = the transcoder predicts the real layer exactly, 0 = no better than always guessing the average, below 0 = worse. Line: 95% interval over features. Values below −1 sit at −1 with an arrow.
panelB: Does copying one neuron predict a feature's miss?
panelB_note: One dot per feature, all four layers. Miss = median over its nudges of |real − transcoder| / (|real| + |transcoder|): 0 = exact, 1 = wrong sign or size. Line: median per 0.1 of cosine.
note: Real neurons: one MLP neuron's own input and output directions, used as if it were a feature. 300 features per group and layer (3 draws of 100), up to 8 nudges each, held-out Pile text.
